text: You swallowed gum. It lives in you for seven years.
Everyone's heard it. So he circles the calendar and waits.
Gum base is indigestible. Nothing in your body can break it down.
But so are corn kernels, and they leave. Your gut just pushes it along with the food.
Within days, it's gone. Doctors who look inside stomachs don't find old wads.
Real trouble is rare: kids swallowing lots of gum over time.
So the seven years were a lie. Anyway, I have another piece.
